notes: Local macOS measurements, not production capacity. Raw timings include Playwright and DOM polling.
beforeBrowser is an additional run of the immutable before JAR without concurrent build/test work. The first before run overlapped a Java verification and is retained separately.
Each browser series has 3 fresh Spring processes. Each adapter series has 3 separate test JVMs. Do not pool unrelated phases.
Original logs, full manifests, diagnostics and JAR copies remain in ignored artifacts/t10-1. Only absolute JVM directory properties are omitted from this public data.
failedHistoryFixture used insertText with CR; history preparation was corrected to the existing type-and-Enter action before comparative runs.
Initial failed reports use elapsedMs relative to the RSS sampler; final reports use startedAtMs/observedAtMs on the same worker monotonic clock.
